scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsr generate && tsc && tsc -p test
scripts.auth:schema: aube dlx auth@1.7.16 generate --config src/server/auth/cli.ts --output src/server/db/auth-schema.ts --yes
scripts.ci: aube run commands --check && aube run check && aube run typecheck && aube run test && aube run dev:setup && aube run build && aube run test:e2e

scriptsInfo.dev: Run the app on http://localhost:4710 (the Worker in workerd, D1 and the Durable Object local)
scriptsInfo.preview: Serve the production build on http://localhost:4711
scriptsInfo.snapshot: Save the built home page as static files in dist/snapshot/, for the artifact viewer
scriptsInfo.typegen: Regenerate the Worker's types (worker-configuration.d.ts) and the route tree
scriptsInfo.typecheck: Type-check the app and the tests (regenerates types first)
scriptsInfo.format: Biome: fix formatting and safe lint fixes
scriptsInfo.test: Vitest: unit tests in Node, and the Durable Object in workerd with the real wrangler.jsonc
scriptsInfo.test:e2e: Playwright on the production build (after aube run build) in installed Chrome, with nobody signed in: the booker, the sign-in button, no passwords, and Hallmark's lint on every page. Signed in, through the real Gateweave ID, is mise run all:e2e
scriptsInfo.hallmark: Just the Hallmark spec of test:e2e: Hallmark's sloplint on the rendered production build (after aube run build), every page at its widths; fails on anything but clean
scriptsInfo.auth:schema: Regenerate the Better Auth tables (src/server/db/auth-schema.ts) from src/server/auth/config.ts
scriptsInfo.db:generate: Drizzle: write a migration into migrations/ from the schema
scriptsInfo.db:migrate:local: Apply migrations to the local D1
scriptsInfo.dev:setup: One-time: write .dev.vars with a random BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and migrate the local D1
scriptsInfo.ci: Everything CI runs, in order: check, typecheck, test, dev:setup (the build carries .dev.vars to the built Worker), build, test:e2e (Hallmark's lint included). GitHub runs exactly this
scriptsInfo.commands: Regenerate docs/commands.md from these scripts (--check fails if it is out of date)
